LegalPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
LegalPrivacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Luis Castillo, a natural person domiciled in Colombia, data controller for Challenge Dynasty (including Padelito Shop / DINASTY Marketplace), collects, uses, stores and protects your personal data, in compliance with Law 1581 of 2012, Decree 1377 of 2013 and other Colombian personal data protection rules ("Habeas Data").
LegalPrivacy.s1Body:
Controller: Luis Castillo, natural person, Colombia.
Contact for privacy and data protection matters: privacidad@challenge-dynasty.com.
LegalPrivacy.s2Body:
We collect the following categories of data:
- Identification and profile data: name, username, email address, city, country, profile photo.
- Sports data: sports played, skill level, challenge and tournament results, ranking statistics.
- Dynasty AI usage data: messages you send to the assistant and its generated responses, used to provide context and memory across the conversation.
- Social content data: posts, comments, photos you choose to share.
- Transaction data: order history in Padelito Shop / DINASTY Marketplace and club bookings (we do not store your full card numbers; these are processed directly by Wompi and Shopify).
- Technical data: IP address, device type, usage logs, for security and service-improvement purposes.
LegalPrivacy.s3Body:
We use your data to:
- Create and manage your account and sports profile.
- Operate the challenges, tournaments, ranking, booking and marketplace features.
- Personalize and provide context to Dynasty AI's responses.
- Process payments and orders through Wompi and Shopify.
- Send you service-related notifications (results, reminders, updates).
- Prevent fraud and protect the security of the Platform.
- Comply with legal obligations.
LegalPrivacy.s4Body: When you use Dynasty AI, your messages and certain profile information (authorized context) are sent to a third-party AI model provider to generate a response. We store your Dynasty AI conversation history to give you continuity and memory across sessions. We do not use your Dynasty AI conversations to train third-party models, nor do we share them for advertising purposes.
LegalPrivacy.s5Title: 5. Who we share your data with
LegalPrivacy.s5Body:
We share personal data only with:
- Infrastructure and database providers (Supabase) that store the Platform's information.
- Payment providers (Wompi, Shopify) to process purchases and orders.
- Artificial intelligence model providers, to operate Dynasty AI.
- Hosting and deployment providers (Vercel).
- Competent authorities, when there is a legal obligation to do so.
We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
LegalPrivacy.s6Body: Your data is stored in databases with security controls, including row-level security policies that restrict access to your own information. We apply reasonable technical and administrative security measures; however, no system is infallible, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
LegalPrivacy.s7Body:
Under Law 1581 of 2012, you have the right to:
- Know, update and correct your personal data.
- Request proof of the authorization granted.
- Be informed about how your data is used.
- File complaints with Colombia's Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC) for violations of the law.
- Revoke your authorization and/or request deletion of your data, when there is no legal or contractual duty preventing it.
- Access your personal data free of charge.
You can exercise these rights by writing to privacidad@challenge-dynasty.com or by deleting your account directly from the Platform's settings.
LegalPrivacy.s8Body: The Platform is not directed at children and adolescents without the supervision of their parents or legal guardians. If you are a minor, processing of your data requires authorization from a parent or legal guardian, in accordance with Article 7 of Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013.
LegalPrivacy.s9Body: Some of our providers (such as cloud infrastructure and AI model providers) may store or process data outside Colombia. In these cases, we adopt reasonable contractual safeguards to protect your information in line with applicable standards.
LegalPrivacy.s10Body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active, and for any additional period required to comply with legal, accounting or defense obligations before authorities. If you request deletion of your account, we will delete or anonymize your personal data, except where we must retain it under a legal obligation.
LegalPrivacy.s11Body: We may update this Privacy Policy. Material changes will be announced within the Platform, together with the date of the last update.
LegalPrivacy.s12Body: To exercise your Habeas Data rights or resolve questions about this Policy, write to us at privacidad@challenge-dynasty.com.
LegalPrivacy.disclaimer: This document is an initial data-protection compliance foundation and does not replace advice from an attorney specialized in personal data protection. Professional legal review is recommended, especially before expanding operations into other countries with different data protection regimes (for example, the GDPR in the European Union).
